name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with feet flat on the floor
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width
Unrack and lower the bar to mid-chest
Press the bar up to full arm extension

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degree incline
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width
Lower the bar to upper chest
Press up to full extension

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Secure legs on a decline bench
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width
Lower the bar to lower chest
Press up to full extension

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on flat bench with hands shoulder-width or narrower
Lower bar to lower chest
Press up focusing on triceps

name: Floor Press
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and feet flat
Grip the barbell at shoulder width and unrack
Lower the bar until upper arms touch the floor
Pause briefly, then press up to lockout

name: Larsen Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with legs extended straight and feet off the floor
Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width
Lower the bar to mid-chest with control
Press up to full extension while maintaining leg position

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells at chest level
Press dumbbells up until arms are extended
Lower with control back to chest level

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degree incline
Press dumbbells from upper chest to full extension
Lower with control

name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Secure legs on a decline bench
Press dumbbells from lower chest to full extension
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells extended above chest
Lower dumbbells in a wide arc with slight elbow bend
Squeeze chest to bring dumbbells back together

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degree incline
Perform fly motion with slight elbow bend
Focus on upper chest squeeze at top

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on the floor holding dumbbells at chest level
Press dumbbells up until arms are fully extended
Lower until upper arms rest on the floor
Pause briefly, then press back up

name: Squeeze Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench pressing two dumbbells together
Keep the dumbbells squeezed together throughout the movement
Press up to full extension maintaining inward pressure
Lower to chest while keeping dumbbells in contact

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Set cable pulleys high
Step forward and bring handles down and together
Squeeze chest at the bottom of the movement

name: Cable Fly
instructions: Set cable pulleys to shoulder height
Step forward with slight lean
Bring handles together in front of chest with slight elbow bend

name: Low Cable Fly
instructions: Set cable pulleys low
Step forward and bring handles up and together
Squeeze upper chest at top

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust seat so handles are at chest height
Press handles forward to full extension
Return with control

name: Pec Deck
instructions: Adjust seat so arms are at chest height
Bring pads together in front of chest
Return slowly to starting position

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench under Smith machine bar
Unrack and lower bar to chest
Press up to full extension

name: Machine Incline Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so handles are at upper chest level
Press the handles forward and up to full extension
Lower with control back to the starting position

name: Smith Machine Incline Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees inside the Smith machine
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width
Unrack and lower the bar to upper chest
Press up to full extension

name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in plank position with hands shoulder-width apart
Lower chest to the ground
Push back up to starting position

name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Place hands together in diamond shape under chest
Lower chest to hands
Push back up

name: Decline Push-Up
instructions: Place feet on an elevated surface with hands on the floor
Set hands slightly wider than shoulder-width
Lower chest toward the floor
Push back up to full arm extension

name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Place hands on an elevated surface like a bench or box
Set hands slightly wider than shoulder-width
Lower chest toward the surface
Push back up to full arm extension

name: Wide Push-Up
instructions: Start in push-up position with hands wider than shoulder-width
Lower chest toward the floor keeping elbows flared
Push back up to full arm extension

name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Start in a downward dog position with hips high
Bend elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor
Press back up to the starting position
Keep hips elevated throughout

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Grip parallel bars and lean forward slightly
Lower body until upper arms are parallel to floor
Press back up to starting position

name: Machine Dip
instructions: Sit in dip machine and grip handles
Press down extending arms
Return with control

name: Landmine Press
instructions: Hold end of landmine bar at shoulder
Press up and forward at an angle
Lower with control

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at hips with slight knee bend
Grip bar shoulder-width
Pull bar to lower chest/upper abdomen
Lower with control

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Start with bar on floor, torso parallel to ground
Explosively row bar to lower chest
Return bar to floor each rep

name: Rack Pull
instructions: Set barbell on rack pins at knee height
Grip bar and stand up fully
Lower back to pins with control

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place one knee and hand on bench
Pull dumbbell to hip with other arm
Lower with control

name: Meadows Row
instructions: Stand perpendicular to landmine bar
Hinge at hips and grip end of bar
Row bar to hip
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie across bench with dumbbell held over chest
Lower dumbbell behind head with slight elbow bend
Pull back over chest using lats and chest

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
instructions: Set an incline bench to 30-45 degrees
Lie face down on the bench holding dumbbells
Row both dumbbells up toward your hips, squeezing shoulder blades
Lower with control to full arm extension

name: Kroc Row
instructions: Place one hand on a bench for support with feet staggered
Hold a heavy dumbbell in the other hand at arm's length
Row the dumbbell to your hip using momentum on the last few reps
Focus on high reps with heavy weight and controlled eccentric

name: Gorilla Row
instructions: Stand over two kettlebells or dumbbells in a hip-hinge position
Row one weight up while pressing the other into the floor
Alternate sides with each rep
Keep your back flat and core braced

name: Renegade Row
instructions: Start in a push-up position gripping two dumbbells
Row one dumbbell to your hip while stabilizing on the other
Lower the weight and repeat on the other side
Keep hips square to the floor throughout

name: Seal Row
instructions: Lie face down on an elevated bench with arms hanging straight down
Hold a barbell or dumbbells at arm's length
Row the weight up toward the bench, squeezing shoulder blades
Lower with control to full extension

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit with feet on platform and slight knee bend
Pull handle to lower chest
Squeeze shoulder blades together
Return with control

name: Cable Lateral Pulldown
instructions: Sit at lat pulldown with single handle
Pull handle down to shoulder
Squeeze lat and return with control

name: Cable Pullover
instructions: Stand facing high cable with straight bar
Keep arms straight and pull bar down to thighs
Return with control

name: Face Pull
instructions: Set cable at face height with rope
Pull rope toward face separating ends
Squeeze rear delts and external rotate

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip bar wider than shoulder-width
Pull bar to upper chest
Squeeze lats at bottom
Return with control

name: Lat Pulldown (Close Grip)
instructions: Attach close-grip or V-bar handle
Pull down to upper chest
Squeeze lats at bottom
Return with control

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with a bar attachment at the top
With arms straight, pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs
Squeeze your lats at the bottom
Return slowly to the starting position

name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at a lat pulldown machine with a single handle attachment
Pull the handle down to your side, focusing on one lat
Squeeze at the bottom and control the return

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip the bar wider than shoulder-width at a lat pulldown station
Pull the bar down to your upper chest
Squeeze your lats at the bottom
Return with control to full arm extension

name: Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip the lat pulldown bar with an underhand grip at shoulder-width
Pull the bar down to your upper chest
Focus on squeezing the lower lats
Return with control to full extension

name: Single-Arm Cable Row
instructions: Set a cable to mid-height with a single handle
Stand or kneel and pull the handle toward your hip
Squeeze your shoulder blade at full contraction
Return slowly to the starting position

name: Machine Row
instructions: Sit with chest against pad
Pull handles back squeezing shoulder blades
Return with control

name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Sit facing the pec deck machine
Grip handles with arms extended forward
Open arms squeezing rear delts
Return with control

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle the barbell with close-grip handle
Hinge at hips and pull bar to chest
Lower with control

name: Chest-Supported Machine Row
instructions: Sit with chest against the pad on the machine row
Grip the handles and pull toward your torso
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at full contraction
Return with control

name: Assisted Pull-Up Machine
instructions: Set the counterweight to desired assistance level
Kneel or stand on the platform and grip the handles
Pull yourself up until chin is above the bar
Lower with control to full arm extension

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from bar with overhand grip wider than shoulders
Pull up until chin clears bar
Lower with control

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from bar with underhand shoulder-width grip
Pull up until chin clears bar
Lower with control

name: Hyperextension
instructions: Position hips on pad with feet secured
Lower torso toward floor
Extend back up to neutral spine

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Set a barbell in a rack at waist height
Hang underneath with arms extended and body straight
Pull your chest to the bar by squeezing shoulder blades
Lower with control back to full extension

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Grip parallel handles with palms facing each other
Pull yourself up until chin clears the handles
Lower with control to full arm extension

name: Muscle-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a false grip
Pull explosively, transitioning from below to above the bar
Press up to full arm extension on top of the bar
Lower back down with control

name: Scapular Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms fully extended
Without bending your elbows, retract and depress your shoulder blades
Hold the top position briefly
Relax back to a dead hang and repeat

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold barbell with overhand grip at hip level
Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears
Hold briefly at top
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides
Shrug shoulders straight up
Hold briefly at top and lower

name: Landmine Row
instructions: Straddle the end of a loaded landmine barbell
Hinge at the hips and grip the bar with both hands or a V-handle
Row the bar toward your chest
Lower with control

name: Cable Shrug
instructions: Stand between two low cable pulleys holding the handles
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears
Hold the top position briefly
Lower with control

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Hold barbell at shoulder height with overhand grip
Press bar overhead to full extension
Lower back to shoulders with control

name: Push Press
instructions: Hold a barbell at shoulder height in the front rack position
Dip your knees slightly and drive the bar overhead using leg drive
Lock out arms at the top
Lower the bar back to shoulders with control

name: Behind-the-Neck Press
instructions: Sit or stand with a barbell resting behind your neck on your traps
Press the bar overhead to full lockout
Lower the bar back behind your neck with control
Use lighter weight and ensure adequate shoulder mobility

name: Bradford Press
instructions: Start with a barbell at the front rack position at shoulder height
Press the bar just high enough to clear your head
Lower behind your neck, then immediately press back over to the front
Alternate front-to-back without locking out

name: Z Press
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended straight in front
Clean or rack a barbell to shoulder height
Press the bar overhead to full lockout without leaning back
Lower with control back to shoulders

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit with dumbbells at shoulder height
Press both dumbbells overhead
Lower with control

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start with dumbbells in front of shoulders, palms facing you
Rotate palms outward while pressing overhead
Reverse the rotation while lowering

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides
Raise arms out to sides until parallel with floor
Lower with control

name: Front Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells in front of thighs
Raise one or both arms to shoulder height
Lower with control

name: Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Bend at hips with dumbbells hanging below
Raise arms out to sides squeezing rear delts
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Y Raise
instructions: Stand or lie face down on an incline bench holding light dumbbells
Raise the dumbbells up and out at a 45-degree angle forming a Y shape
Lower with control back to the starting position

name: Dumbbell Lu Raise
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides
Perform a lateral raise to shoulder height
At the top, rotate and press the dumbbells overhead
Reverse the motion back to starting position

name: Dumbbell W Raise
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding light dumbbells
Raise the dumbbells with elbows bent to form a W shape
Squeeze shoulder blades together at the top
Lower with control

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand sideways to low cable
Raise arm out to side to shoulder height
Lower with control

name: Upright Row
instructions: Hold barbell with narrow grip at hips
Pull bar up to chin level keeping elbows high
Lower with control

name: Cable Front Raise
instructions: Stand facing away from a low cable with a handle or rope
With arm straight, raise the handle forward to shoulder height
Lower with control back to your side

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Set cables to shoulder height with crossover handles
Pull the handles outward and back, squeezing rear delts
Control the return to the starting position

name: Cable Upright Row
instructions: Stand facing a low cable pulley with a straight bar attachment
Pull the bar up along your body toward chin height
Keep elbows high and lead with your elbows
Lower with control

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit with back against pad
Press handles overhead
Lower with control

name: Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit in machine with pads against outer arms
Raise arms out to sides
Lower with control

name: Machine Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Sit facing the pad on a pec deck or rear delt machine
Grip the handles and push them back in a reverse fly motion
Squeeze your rear delts at full contraction
Return with control

name: Handstand Push-Up
instructions: Kick up into a handstand against a wall
Lower yourself by bending your elbows until your head lightly touches the floor
Press back up to full arm extension
Maintain a tight core throughout

name: Landmine Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with one end of a landmine barbell at your side
Grip the end of the bar with the working hand
Raise the bar out to the side to shoulder height
Lower with control

name: Plate Front Raise
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate with both hands at waist level
Raise the plate forward and up to shoulder height with arms straight
Lower with control

name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold a resistance band in front of you at shoulder height with arms extended
Pull the band apart by squeezing your shoulder blades together
Return to the starting position with control

name: Bus Driver
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate with both hands at arm's length in front
Rotate the plate like a steering wheel, alternating sides
Keep arms extended and core braced throughout

name: Dumbbell External Rotation
instructions: Lie on your side with a light dumbbell in the top hand
Keep your upper arm pinned to your side with elbow bent at 90 degrees
Rotate your forearm upward away from your body
Lower with control back to the starting position

name: Cable External Rotation
instructions: Stand sideways to a cable set at elbow height
Keep your elbow pinned to your side bent at 90 degrees
Rotate your forearm outward away from the cable
Return with control

name: Cable Internal Rotation
instructions: Stand sideways to a cable set at elbow height
Keep your elbow pinned to your side bent at 90 degrees
Rotate your forearm inward toward your body
Return with control

name: Band External Rotation
instructions: Attach a band at elbow height and stand sideways
Keep your elbow pinned to your side bent at 90 degrees
Rotate your forearm outward against the band's resistance
Return with control

name: Prone Y Raise
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench or the floor with arms hanging down
Raise both arms up and outward to form a Y shape with thumbs up
Squeeze your lower traps at the top
Lower with control

name: Prone T Raise
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench or the floor with arms hanging down
Raise both arms straight out to the sides to form a T shape
Squeeze your mid-back at the top
Lower with control

name: Cuban Press
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with an overhand grip
Perform an upright row to shoulder height
Externally rotate the dumbbells until forearms point up
Press overhead, then reverse the entire sequence

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand with barbell at arm's length, underhand grip
Curl bar up to shoulder height
Lower with control

name: EZ-Bar Curl
instructions: Stand with EZ-bar at arm's length
Curl bar up to shoulder height
Lower with control

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at preacher bench with arms over pad
Curl bar up squeezing biceps
Lower with control

name: Drag Curl
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip
Curl the bar up while dragging it along your torso
Keep your elbows behind the bar throughout
Lower with control along the same path

name: Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand with barbell using overhand grip
Curl bar up keeping overhand grip
Lower with control

name: Wide-Grip Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with a wider-than-shoulder underhand grip
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders
Squeeze at the top and lower with control

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms forward
Curl both dumbbells to shoulder height
Lower with control

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms facing each other
Curl dumbbells keeping neutral grip
Lower with control

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit on incline bench with dumbbells hanging
Curl dumbbells up keeping upper arms stationary
Lower with control for full stretch

name: Incline Hammer Curl
instructions: Sit on incline bench with dumbbells hanging
Curl with neutral grip keeping upper arms stationary
Lower with control

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit and brace elbow against inner thigh
Curl dumbbell up squeezing bicep at top
Lower with control

name: Spider Curl
instructions: Lie face down on incline bench
Let arms hang straight down with dumbbells
Curl up squeezing biceps at top

name: Zottman Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with palms facing up
Curl the dumbbells up with a supinated grip
At the top, rotate to a pronated (palms-down) grip
Lower slowly with the pronated grip, then rotate back at the bottom

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides
Curl one dumbbell across your body toward the opposite shoulder
Lower with control and alternate sides

name: Prone Incline Curl
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with arms hanging straight down
Hold dumbbells with palms forward
Curl the dumbbells up while keeping upper arms stationary
Lower with control

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Stand facing low cable with bar or rope
Curl handle up to shoulder height
Lower with control

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
instructions: Face away from low cable holding handle
Arm starts behind body for full stretch
Curl forward squeezing bicep at top

name: Cable Hammer Curl
instructions: Attach a rope to a low cable pulley
Stand facing the machine and grip the rope with neutral grip
Curl the rope up keeping palms facing each other
Lower with control

name: Overhead Cable Curl
instructions: Stand between two high cable pulleys with handles attached
Grip the handles with palms facing up and arms extended to the sides
Curl the handles toward your head by flexing your biceps
Return with control to the starting position

name: Single-Arm Cable Curl
instructions: Stand facing a low cable with a single handle
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder
Squeeze at the top and lower with control

name: Machine Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at preacher curl machine
Curl handle up squeezing biceps
Lower with control

name: Machine Bicep Curl
instructions: Sit at the bicep curl machine with arms on the pad
Grip the handles and curl toward your shoulders
Squeeze at the top and lower with control

name: Chin-Up Curl
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a narrow supinated grip
Pull yourself up focusing on bicep contraction
Lower with control to full extension

name: Body Drag Curl
instructions: Stand upright and mimic a curl motion using body leverage
Drag your hands up along your body using a bar or surface
Focus on the bicep contraction throughout
Lower with control

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on bench with bar extended above chest
Lower bar to forehead by bending elbows
Extend back to starting position

name: JM Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and grip the barbell at close grip width
Lower the bar toward your chin/throat area by bending at the elbows
The bar path combines a skull crusher and close-grip press
Press back to lockout

name: Floor Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on the floor holding an EZ-bar or dumbbells above your chest
Lower the weight toward your forehead by bending at the elbows
Let your upper arms touch the floor briefly
Extend back to the starting position

name: Dumbbell Kickback
instructions: Hinge at hips with upper arm parallel to floor
Extend forearm back until arm is straight
Return with control

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold dumbbell overhead with both hands
Lower behind head by bending elbows
Extend back to starting position

name: Tate Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells above your chest with palms facing your feet
Lower the dumbbells inward toward your chest by bending at the elbows
The dumbbells should touch your chest near the midline
Press back up to full extension

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Extension
instructions: Stand or sit holding one dumbbell overhead with arm fully extended
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending at the elbow
Extend back to the starting position
Keep your upper arm close to your head

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Stand at high cable with rope or bar attachment
Push weight down extending elbows fully
Return with control keeping elbows at sides

name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown
instructions: Stand at high cable with single handle
Push down extending elbow fully
Return with control

name: Cable Overhead Extension
instructions: Face away from low cable with rope overhead
Extend arms forward and up
Return with control behind head

name: Tricep Pushdown (Rope)
instructions: Attach a rope to a high cable pulley
Grip the rope with neutral grip and elbows at your sides
Push down and spread the rope apart at the bottom
Return with control to the starting position

name: Tricep Pushdown (Reverse Grip)
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high cable pulley
Grip the bar with an underhand (supinated) grip
Push down to full arm extension keeping elbows pinned
Return with control

name: Cable Kickback
instructions: Set a cable to the lowest position with a single handle
Hinge forward and keep your upper arm parallel to your torso
Extend your forearm back until your arm is straight
Return with control

name: Machine Tricep Extension
instructions: Sit at the tricep extension machine and grip the handles
Extend your arms fully against the resistance
Return with control to the starting position

name: Assisted Dip Machine
instructions: Set the counterweight to desired assistance level
Kneel or stand on the platform and grip the dip handles
Lower your body by bending your elbows to 90 degrees
Press back up to full extension

name: Tricep Dip
instructions: Grip parallel bars with upright torso
Lower body until elbows are at 90 degrees
Press back up to full extension

name: Bench Dip
instructions: Place your hands on the edge of a bench behind you with fingers forward
Extend your legs out in front
Lower your body by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees
Press back up to full extension

name: Bodyweight Tricep Extension
instructions: Place your hands on a bar or surface at about waist height
Lean forward with arms extended and body at an angle
Lower your head under the bar by bending at the elbows
Press back to the starting position

name: Band Pushdown
instructions: Attach a resistance band to a high anchor point
Grip the band with both hands at chest height
Push down to full arm extension keeping elbows at your sides
Return with control

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit with forearms on thighs, wrists over knees
Curl bar up using only wrists
Lower with control

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit with forearms on thighs, palms facing down
Extend wrists up
Lower with control

name: Behind-the-Back Wrist Curl
instructions: Stand holding a barbell behind your back with an underhand grip
Curl your wrists upward, flexing the forearms
Lower with control and repeat

name: Farmer's Walk
instructions: Hold heavy dumbbells at sides
Walk with upright posture for distance or time
Maintain tight grip throughout

name: Plate Pinch Hold
instructions: Pinch two weight plates together smooth-side-out between your fingers and thumb
Hold at your side with arm extended for time
Focus on gripping with fingertips

name: Towel Pull-Up
instructions: Drape a towel over a pull-up bar and grip each end
Perform a pull-up while squeezing the towel tightly
Lower with control to full extension

name: Fat Grip Barbell Hold
instructions: Attach fat grips to a barbell or use a thick bar
Deadlift the bar to lockout and hold for time
Focus on maintaining grip

name: Wrist Roller
instructions: Hold a wrist roller device with arms extended in front
Roll the weight up by alternately flexing each wrist
Reverse the motion to lower the weight
Keep arms parallel to the floor throughout

name: Pronation/Supination
instructions: Hold a light dumbbell or hammer by one end with elbow at your side
Rotate your forearm inward (pronation) then outward (supination)
Perform slowly with control through full range of motion

name: Finger Curl
instructions: Hold a barbell with an overhand grip and let it roll to your fingertips
Curl your fingers to bring the bar back into your palm
Squeeze at the top and lower with control

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Position bar on upper back/traps
Descend by breaking at hips and knees
Squat to parallel or below
Drive up through heels

name: Front Squat
instructions: Rest bar on front delts with clean or cross grip
Squat down keeping torso upright
Drive up through heels

name: Box Squat
instructions: Set up box at parallel squat depth
Squat down to box with controlled descent
Pause briefly on box
Drive up explosively

name: Pause Squat
instructions: Perform a back squat
Pause for 2-3 seconds at the bottom
Drive up explosively

name: Safety Bar Squat
instructions: Position safety squat bar on upper back
Grip the handles in front
Squat down to parallel and drive up

name: Zercher Squat
instructions: Hold barbell in crook of elbows
Squat down keeping torso upright
Drive up through heels

name: Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with wide stance holding dumbbell between legs
Squat down keeping torso upright
Drive up through heels

name: Overhead Squat
instructions: Hold a barbell overhead with a wide snatch grip
Squat down while keeping the bar directly overhead
Keep your chest up and core braced
Drive back up to standing

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold dumbbell at chest level with both hands
Squat down keeping torso upright
Drive up through heels

name: Dumbbell Squat
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides
Squat down until thighs are parallel to the floor
Drive through your heels to stand back up

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides with one foot elevated behind you on a bench
Lower your back knee toward the floor
Drive through the front foot to return to standing

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in leg press with feet shoulder-width on platform
Lower platform by bending knees to 90 degrees
Press platform back up without locking knees

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit in machine with pad on lower shins
Extend legs to full lockout
Lower with control

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Stand on platform with back against pad
Squat down to parallel
Drive up through heels

name: Pendulum Squat
instructions: Stand on pendulum squat machine platform
Squat down maintaining upright torso
Drive back up

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Position bar on upper back in Smith machine
Squat down to parallel
Drive up through heels

name: Belt Squat
instructions: Attach a weight belt to a belt squat machine or low pulley
Stand on the platform with feet shoulder-width apart
Squat down until thighs are parallel
Drive up to standing

name: V-Squat Machine
instructions: Stand on the V-squat machine platform with shoulders under the pads
Squat down until thighs are parallel to the floor
Drive up to the starting position

name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand holding a support for balance
Lean back and bend knees forward
Lower until deep stretch in quads
Return to standing

name: Single-Leg Leg Press
instructions: Sit on the leg press machine and place one foot on the platform
Lower the sled by bending your knee to 90 degrees
Press the sled back up to full extension
Complete all reps on one side before switching

name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other leg extended straight in front
Squat down as deep as possible while keeping the raised leg off the floor
Drive back up to standing on one leg
Use arms for counterbalance as needed

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart
Squat down until thighs are parallel to the floor
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over toes
Drive through your heels to stand back up

name: Jump Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart
Squat down to parallel, then explode upward into a jump
Land softly with knees slightly bent
Immediately descend into the next rep

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Stand with your back flat against a wall
Slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor
Keep your back pressed against the wall and hold the position
Hold for the prescribed duration

name: Cyclist Squat
instructions: Stand with heels elevated on small plates and feet close together
Squat straight down keeping your torso upright
Focus on quad engagement with knees traveling forward
Drive back up to standing

name: Split Squat
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance with one foot forward
Lower your back knee toward the floor
Drive through the front foot to return to standing
Keep your torso upright throughout

name: Cossack Squat
instructions: Stand with a wide stance, toes pointed slightly outward
Shift your weight to one leg and squat down on that side
Keep the opposite leg straight with foot flat on the floor
Return to center and alternate sides

name: Landmine Squat
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine barbell at chest height
Squat down until thighs are parallel
Drive up to standing
Keep the bar close to your chest throughout

name: Spanish Squat
instructions: Loop a band behind your knees and anchor it to a fixed point
Lean back into the band and squat down
Keep your shins vertical and focus on quad engagement
Drive back up to standing

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold bar at hip level with overhand grip
Hinge at hips pushing butt back
Lower bar along legs with slight knee bend
Return to standing by driving hips forward

name: Good Morning
instructions: Position bar on upper back
Hinge at hips pushing butt back
Lower torso until nearly parallel
Return to standing

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip
Hinge at the hips with legs nearly straight (slight knee bend)
Lower the bar along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch
Drive hips forward to return to standing

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg holding dumbbell
Hinge at hip extending other leg behind
Lower until torso is parallel to floor
Return to standing

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back while keeping a slight knee bend
Lower the dumbbells along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch
Drive hips forward to return to standing

name: Cable Pull-Through
instructions: Face away from low cable with rope between legs
Hinge at hips reaching back
Drive hips forward to standing

name: Cable Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand facing a low cable pulley with a bar attachment
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back while keeping a slight knee bend
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch
Drive hips forward to return to standing

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on leg curl machine
Curl pad toward glutes
Lower with control

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit in machine with pad behind ankles
Curl legs under the seat
Return with control

name: Single-Leg Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on a leg curl machine with one leg under the pad
Curl your heel toward your glute
Lower with control and complete all reps before switching

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel with feet secured behind you
Slowly lower torso toward ground using hamstrings
Push off floor to assist return if needed

name: Glute Ham Raise
instructions: Position in GHD machine with knees on pad
Lower torso forward with control
Curl back up using hamstrings and glutes

name: Sliding Leg Curl
instructions: Lie on your back with heels on sliders or a towel on a smooth floor
Bridge your hips up and slide your feet away from you
Curl your feet back toward your glutes while maintaining the bridge
Maintain hip extension throughout

name: Reverse Nordic Curl
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your torso upright
Slowly lean back by extending at the knees, keeping hips extended
Go as far back as you can control
Use your quads to pull yourself back upright

name: Banded Good Morning
instructions: Loop a band under your feet and over the back of your neck
Hinge at the hips with a slight knee bend
Push your hips back until you feel a hamstring stretch
Drive hips forward to return to standing

name: Hip Hinge (Band)
instructions: Loop a band around your hips anchored behind you
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart facing away from the anchor
Hinge at the hips against the band's resistance
Drive hips forward to standing

name: 45-Degree Back Extension
instructions: Position yourself on a 45-degree back extension bench with hips at the pad edge
Cross arms over chest or behind your head
Lower your torso toward the floor by hinging at the hips
Raise back up until your body is in line with your legs

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on floor with upper back against bench
Roll barbell over hips
Drive hips up until body forms straight line
Lower with control

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on floor with barbell over hips
Drive hips up squeezing glutes
Lower with control

name: Barbell Lunge
instructions: Position barbell on upper back
Step forward into lunge
Lower until back knee nearly touches floor
Push back to standing

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides
Step forward into lunge position
Drive through front foot and step forward with other leg
Continue alternating

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Place rear foot on bench behind you
Hold dumbbells at sides
Descend until front thigh is parallel
Drive up through front heel

name: Step-Up
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides facing a box or bench
Step up onto platform with one foot
Drive through heel to stand fully on platform
Step down with control

name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a barbell on your back or dumbbells at sides
Step one foot backward and lower your back knee toward the floor
Drive through the front foot to return to standing
Alternate legs or complete all reps on one side

name: Deficit Lunge
instructions: Stand on a small platform or step holding dumbbells at your sides
Step forward off the platform into a lunge
Lower your back knee toward the floor for extended range of motion
Drive through the front foot to return to the platform

name: Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart
Step one foot behind and across your body in a curtsy motion
Lower your back knee toward the floor
Drive through the front foot to return to standing

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
instructions: Set up a bench and position yourself under a Smith machine bar
Place the bar across your hips with a pad
Drive your hips up toward the ceiling, squeezing glutes at the top
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides
Step out wide to one side
Bend stepping leg while keeping other leg straight
Push back to start

name: Dumbbell Lunge
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides
Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor
Drive through the front foot to return to standing
Alternate legs

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides facing a box or bench
Step one foot onto the platform and drive up to standing
Step back down with control
Complete all reps on one side before switching

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with upper back against a bench and a dumbbell on your hips
Drive your hips up toward the ceiling, squeezing glutes at the top
Lower with control back to the starting position

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
instructions: Set up as for a hip thrust with upper back on a bench
Extend one leg straight out and drive up with the working leg
Squeeze glute at the top and lower with control
Complete all reps on one side before switching

name: Cable Hip Extension
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable pulley
Stand facing the machine and kick the working leg straight back
Squeeze the glute at full extension
Return with control

name: Machine Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit in hip thrust machine with back against pad
Drive hips up against resistance
Squeeze glutes at top and lower

name: Hip Abductor Machine
instructions: Sit in machine with pads against outer thighs
Push legs apart against resistance
Return with control

name: Cable Hip Abduction
instructions: Attach ankle cuff to low cable
Stand sideways and raise leg out to side
Lower with control

name: Reverse Hyperextension
instructions: Lie face down on a reverse hyper machine or high bench with hips at the edge
Let your legs hang down
Raise your legs by extending your hips until they are in line with your torso
Lower with control

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor
Drive your hips up toward the ceiling, squeezing glutes at the top
Lower with control back to the floor

name: Frog Pump
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees out
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes
Lower with control and repeat for high reps

name: Fire Hydrant
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips
Keeping your knee bent at 90 degrees, lift one leg out to the side
Raise until your thigh is parallel to the floor
Lower with control and repeat

name: Hip Adductor Machine
instructions: Sit in machine with pads against inner thighs
Squeeze legs together against resistance
Return with control

name: Cable Hip Adduction
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable pulley
Stand sideways to the machine with the working leg closest to the cable
Pull the working leg across your body toward the midline
Return with control

name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Lie on your side and place the top leg on an elevated surface like a bench
Lift your body off the floor, supporting with your forearm and top leg
Hold the position, engaging your adductors
Keep your body in a straight line

name: Band Hip Adduction
instructions: Attach a band to a low anchor point and loop around one ankle
Stand sideways and pull the banded leg across your body
Control the return against the band's resistance

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on platform with balls of feet
Rise up onto toes as high as possible
Lower heels below platform for full stretch

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit with knees under pad and balls of feet on platform
Rise up onto toes
Lower for full stretch

name: Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Bend at hips on donkey calf machine
Rise up on toes as high as possible
Lower for full stretch

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
instructions: Sit in leg press with balls of feet on edge of platform
Push through toes extending ankles
Return with control

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
instructions: Stand under a Smith machine bar on a raised platform or step
Place the bar on your shoulders and rise up onto your toes
Hold briefly at the top, then lower your heels below the step
Repeat for full range of motion

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on one foot on the edge of a step or platform
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible
Lower your heel below the step for a full stretch
Complete all reps before switching legs

name: Tibialis Raise
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and heels about a foot away
Raise your toes off the floor as high as possible
Lower with control
You can also use a tib raise machine if available

name: Barbell Calf Raise
instructions: Stand holding a barbell on your back with feet hip-width apart
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible
Hold briefly at the top
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides on the edge of a step
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible
Lower your heels below the step for a full stretch

name: Jump Rope Calf Bounce
instructions: Jump rope staying on the balls of your feet
Keep jumps small and quick, minimizing ground contact time
Focus on calf engagement rather than height

name: Calf Raise (Bodyweight)
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step or flat on the floor
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible
Lower with control and repeat

name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent
Curl shoulders off floor contracting abs
Lower with control

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on back with hands behind head
Bring opposite elbow to knee while extending other leg
Alternate sides in pedaling motion

name: Decline Sit-Up
instructions: Secure feet on decline bench
Lower torso back
Sit up contracting abs

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel facing high cable with rope behind head
Crunch down toward floor contracting abs
Return with control

name: Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor
Place hands behind your head or across your chest
Curl your torso all the way up to your knees
Lower with control back to the floor

name: V-Up
instructions: Lie flat on your back with arms extended overhead
Simultaneously raise your legs and torso to touch your toes at the top
Lower with control back to the starting position

name: Weighted Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent holding a weight plate on your chest
Crunch up, lifting your shoulder blades off the floor
Squeeze your abs at the top and lower with control

name: Machine Crunch
instructions: Sit in the ab crunch machine with feet under the pads
Grip the handles and crunch your torso forward
Squeeze your abs at the bottom
Return with control

name: GHD Sit-Up
instructions: Sit on a GHD machine with feet secured and hips at the pad edge
Lower your torso back until nearly parallel to the floor
Use your abs and hip flexors to sit back up
Touch the floor behind you for full range if possible

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from pull-up bar
Raise legs until parallel to floor or higher
Lower with control

name: Toes-to-Bar
instructions: Hang from pull-up bar
Raise feet up to touch the bar
Lower with control

name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie flat on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips
Raise your legs until they are perpendicular to the floor
Lower with control without letting your feet touch the floor

name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms fully extended
Raise your knees toward your chest
Lower with control back to a dead hang

name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent at 90 degrees and feet off the floor
Curl your hips off the floor toward your chest
Lower with control back to the starting position

name: Flutter Kick
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and hands under your hips
Lift both legs slightly off the floor
Alternate kicking legs up and down in a small range of motion
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor

name: Scissor Kick
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and hands under your hips
Lift both legs slightly off the floor
Cross legs over each other in a scissoring motion
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor

name: Captain's Chair Leg Raise
instructions: Support yourself on a captain's chair with forearms on the pads
Let your legs hang straight down
Raise your legs straight up in front of you
Lower with control

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent and feet off floor
Lean back slightly
Rotate torso side to side touching floor

name: Wood Chop
instructions: Set cable high or low
Pull handle diagonally across body
Rotate through core
Return with control

name: Pallof Press
instructions: Stand sideways to cable at chest height
Press handle straight out in front
Hold resisting rotation
Return to chest

name: Oblique Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat
Place hands behind your head
Crunch up and rotate, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee
Lower and alternate sides

name: Landmine Rotation
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine barbell at chest height with both hands
Rotate the bar from one side to the other in an arc
Keep your arms extended and rotate through your core
Control the movement through the full range

name: Cable Woodchop (High to Low)
instructions: Set a cable to the highest position with a rope or handle
Stand sideways to the machine and grip with both hands
Pull the cable diagonally from high to low across your body
Control the return to the starting position

name: Cable Woodchop (Low to High)
instructions: Set a cable to the lowest position with a rope or handle
Stand sideways to the machine and grip with both hands
Pull the cable diagonally from low to high across your body
Control the return to the starting position

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side
Bend sideways toward the weight, then contract your obliques to return upright
Complete all reps on one side before switching

name: Windshield Wiper
instructions: Lie on your back with arms extended to the sides for support
Raise your legs perpendicular to the floor
Rotate your legs from side to side like a windshield wiper
Keep your shoulders pressed into the floor

name: Ab Rollout
instructions: Kneel with ab wheel or barbell in front
Roll forward extending body
Use abs to pull back to starting position

name: Plank
instructions: Support body on forearms and toes
Keep body in straight line
Hold for prescribed time

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on side supported on forearm
Raise hips creating straight line from head to feet
Hold for prescribed time

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on back with arms extended up and knees bent at 90 degrees
Simultaneously lower opposite arm and leg
Return to start and alternate sides

name: Hollow Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight
Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor, forming a slight banana shape
Press your lower back into the floor and hold
Maintain the position for the prescribed duration

name: Body Saw
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with feet on sliders or a towel
Shift your body forward and backward by moving through your shoulders
Maintain a rigid plank position throughout
Keep your core braced

name: Stir the Pot
instructions: Place your forearms on a stability ball in a plank position
Make small circles with your forearms, moving the ball
Alternate clockwise and counterclockwise
Keep your core tight and hips level

name: Weighted Plank
instructions: Set up in a forearm plank position
Have a partner place a weight plate on your upper back
Hold the position for the prescribed duration
Keep your body in a straight line

name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips
Simultaneously extend one arm forward and the opposite leg backward
Hold briefly at full extension
Return to starting position and alternate sides

name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Start on all fours with knees hovering just above the floor
Move forward by stepping opposite hand and foot simultaneously
Keep your hips low and core braced
Maintain a flat back throughout

name: Neck Curl
instructions: Lie face up on a bench with your head hanging off the end
Place a light plate or towel on your forehead for resistance
Curl your chin toward your chest by flexing your neck
Lower with control

name: Neck Extension
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your head hanging off the end
Place a light plate on the back of your head for resistance
Extend your neck upward, raising your head
Lower with control

name: Neck Lateral Flexion
instructions: Stand or sit and place your hand against the side of your head
Press your head sideways against your hand's resistance
Perform slowly and with control
Complete all reps on one side before switching

name: Neck Harness Extension
instructions: Wear a neck harness with weight attached
Bend forward at the waist and let your head hang down
Extend your neck to raise your head upward against the weight
Lower with control

name: Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, bar over mid-foot
Hinge at hips and grip bar
Drive through floor extending hips and knees simultaneously
Stand fully upright then lower with control

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Stand with wide stance, toes pointed out
Grip bar inside knees
Drive through heels and extend hips to stand
Lower with control

name: Deficit Deadlift
instructions: Stand on a small platform or plates
Perform conventional deadlift with increased range of motion

name: Snatch-Grip Deadlift
instructions: Take a very wide grip on the bar
Perform a deadlift with increased upper back demand
Stand fully upright

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: Stand inside trap bar
Grip handles at sides
Drive through heels to stand
Lower with control

name: Jefferson Deadlift
instructions: Straddle a barbell with one foot in front and one behind
Grip the bar with one hand in front and one behind
Stand up by extending your hips and knees
Lower with control

name: Suitcase Deadlift
instructions: Stand beside a barbell or dumbbell on the floor
Grip the weight with one hand like picking up a suitcase
Stand up by extending hips and knees, keeping your torso upright
Lower with control

name: Power Clean
instructions: Start with bar on floor in deadlift position
Explosively pull bar up
Catch bar on front delts in partial squat
Stand up fully

name: Clean and Press
instructions: Clean bar to shoulders
Press or jerk bar overhead
Lower back to shoulders then to floor

name: Snatch
instructions: Stand over a barbell with a wide grip
Pull the bar explosively from the floor to overhead in one motion
Receive the bar in an overhead squat position
Stand up to complete the lift

name: Clean
instructions: Stand over a barbell with a shoulder-width grip
Pull the bar explosively from the floor to the front rack position
Receive the bar on your shoulders with elbows high
Stand up to complete the lift

name: Hang Clean
instructions: Hold a barbell at hip height in a standing position
Hinge slightly then explosively pull the bar to the front rack
Receive the bar on your shoulders with elbows high
Stand up to complete the lift

name: Hang Snatch
instructions: Hold a barbell at hip height with a wide snatch grip
Hinge slightly then explosively pull the bar overhead
Receive in an overhead squat position
Stand up to complete the lift

name: Clean and Jerk
instructions: Clean the barbell to your shoulders from the floor
Dip your knees and drive the bar overhead with a split or push jerk
Lock out the bar overhead and bring feet together
Lower with control

name: Push Jerk
instructions: Hold a barbell in the front rack position at your shoulders
Dip your knees and explosively drive the bar overhead
Receive the bar with a slight re-bend of the knees
Stand up to lockout

name: Muscle Snatch
instructions: Hold a barbell with a wide snatch grip at hip height
Pull the bar overhead in a strict pressing motion without dropping under
Keep the bar close to your body throughout
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Snatch
instructions: Stand over a dumbbell on the floor with one hand
Pull it explosively from the floor to overhead in one motion
Lock out your arm at the top
Lower with control and alternate sides

name: Dumbbell Clean and Press
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides
Clean the dumbbells to your shoulders with a hip drive
Press them overhead to full lockout
Lower with control back to your sides

name: Kettlebell Snatch
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell between your feet
Swing the kettlebell back between your legs then explosively drive it overhead
Lock out at the top with arm fully extended
Lower with control in one fluid motion

name: Kettlebell Clean
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell between your feet
Swing it back then explosively pull to the rack position at your shoulder
The kettlebell should rest on the back of your forearm
Lower with control

name: Thruster
instructions: Hold bar in front rack position
Squat to parallel
Drive up explosively and press bar overhead in one motion

name: Turkish Get-Up
instructions: Lie on back holding kettlebell at arm's length
Stand up through a series of controlled movements
Reverse the sequence to return to floor

name: Sled Push
instructions: Grip sled handles at desired height
Drive through legs pushing sled forward
Maintain forward lean

name: Battle Ropes
instructions: Hold one end of rope in each hand
Create waves by alternating arm movements
Maintain athletic stance throughout

name: Sled Pull
instructions: Attach a rope or straps to a loaded sled
Walk backward or pull the sled toward you hand over hand
Keep your core braced and maintain a low stance
Reset and repeat for prescribed distance or reps

name: Tire Flip
instructions: Squat down and grip the bottom edge of a heavy tire
Drive up with your legs and hips to lift the tire
As it rises, transition to pushing with your hands
Flip the tire over and repeat

name: Yoke Walk
instructions: Step under a loaded yoke and position the bar on your upper back
Stand up and walk forward with controlled steps
Keep your core braced and take short, quick steps
Walk for the prescribed distance

name: Trap Bar Carry
instructions: Stand inside a loaded trap bar and deadlift it up
Walk forward with controlled steps holding the bar at your sides
Keep your core braced and shoulders back
Walk for the prescribed distance

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at chest height
Squat down until thighs are parallel or deeper
Keep your elbows inside your knees and chest up
Drive through your heels to stand

name: Kettlebell Press
instructions: Clean a kettlebell to the rack position at your shoulder
Press it overhead to full lockout
Lower with control back to the rack position

name: Kettlebell Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips holding a kettlebell in one hand
Row the kettlebell to your hip, squeezing your back
Lower with control
Complete all reps before switching sides

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell between your feet
Hinge at the hips and grip the handle with both hands
Stand up by driving your hips forward
Lower with control by hinging back

name: Kettlebell Thruster
instructions: Hold two kettlebells in the rack position at your shoulders
Squat down, then drive up explosively and press overhead
Lower the kettlebells back to the rack and descend into the next squat

name: Kettlebell High Pull
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell between your feet
Swing it back, then explosively pull it up to chin height with elbows high
Lower with control in one fluid motion

name: Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm locked out
Slowly hinge at the hip, reaching your free hand toward your foot
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell and arm locked throughout
Return to standing

name: Kettlebell Halo
instructions: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the horns at chest height
Circle it around your head in one direction
Keep the kettlebell close to your head
Alternate directions each set

name: Double Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with two kettlebells between your feet
Hinge and swing both kettlebells back between your legs
Drive your hips forward explosively to swing them to chest height
Let them swing back and repeat

name: Kettlebell Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with a wide stance holding a kettlebell between your legs
Squat down, keeping the kettlebell hanging between your legs
Drive through your heels to stand back up

name: Box Jump
instructions: Stand facing a box or platform
Swing arms and jump onto box
Land softly with both feet
Step down and repeat

name: Broad Jump
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart
Swing your arms back and bend your knees
Jump forward as far as possible, landing softly on both feet
Reset and repeat

name: Depth Jump
instructions: Stand on a box or platform
Step off the box and land on both feet
Immediately jump as high as possible upon landing
Focus on minimizing ground contact time

name: Jump Lunge
instructions: Start in a lunge position
Jump explosively and switch legs in the air
Land softly in a lunge position with the opposite leg forward
Continue alternating

name: Lateral Bound
instructions: Stand on one leg
Jump laterally to the opposite foot, landing softly
Immediately bound back to the starting side
Focus on distance and soft landings

name: Skater Jump
instructions: Stand on one leg
Jump laterally to the opposite foot, swinging your arms across
Land softly and hold briefly for balance
Jump back to the other side

name: Tuck Jump
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart
Jump explosively and tuck your knees to your chest at the peak
Extend your legs and land softly
Reset and repeat

name: Single-Leg Box Jump
instructions: Stand on one leg facing a box
Jump off that leg and land on top of the box
Step back down and repeat
Complete all reps before switching legs

name: Hurdle Hop
instructions: Set up a series of small hurdles or cones
Jump over each hurdle with both feet, landing softly
Minimize ground contact time between hurdles
Focus on height and quick rebounds

name: Plyo Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position
Lower yourself to the floor then push up explosively
Your hands should leave the floor at the top
Land softly and immediately descend into the next rep

name: Medicine Ball Slam
instructions: Hold a medicine ball overhead with both hands
Slam it down to the floor as hard as possible
Squat down to pick it up
Return to starting position and repeat

name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass
instructions: Hold a medicine ball at chest height
Explosively push the ball forward to a partner or wall
Catch the return and repeat
Focus on chest and arm power

name: Medicine Ball Rotational Throw
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall holding a medicine ball at hip height
Rotate your core and throw the ball against the wall
Catch the rebound and rotate back
Complete all reps on one side before switching

name: Wall Ball
instructions: Hold a medicine ball at chest height facing a wall
Squat down, then drive up and throw the ball to a target on the wall
Catch the ball as it comes down and descend into the next squat

name: Box Jump (Step Down)
instructions: Stand facing a box with feet shoulder-width apart
Jump onto the box landing softly with both feet
Step down one foot at a time instead of jumping down
Reset and repeat

name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Sit on the rowing machine and strap your feet in
Grab the handle, drive with your legs first
Follow through by leaning back slightly and pulling to your chest
Return in reverse order: arms, body, legs

name: Assault Bike
instructions: Sit on the bike and grip the handles
Push and pull with your arms while pedaling with your legs
Maintain a consistent pace or follow prescribed intervals

name: Ski Erg
instructions: Stand facing the Ski Erg and grip the handles overhead
Pull the handles down by hinging at the hips and driving with your arms
Return to the starting position and repeat in a rhythmic motion

name: Stair Climber
instructions: Stand on the stair climber and grip the handles lightly
Step at a steady pace, driving through each foot
Maintain an upright posture and avoid leaning on the handles

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Hold the rope handles at hip height with elbows close to your body
Swing the rope overhead and jump over it with both feet
Stay on the balls of your feet with small, quick jumps
Maintain a consistent rhythm

name: Burpee
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart
Drop into a squat, place hands on the floor, and kick feet back to a push-up position
Perform a push-up, jump feet back to hands
Explode up into a jump with arms overhead

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a push-up position with core tight
Drive one knee toward your chest
Quickly switch legs, driving the other knee forward
Continue alternating at a fast pace

name: Sprint
instructions: Set up at a starting line or on a track
Drive out of the start with powerful arm and leg action
Run at maximum effort for the prescribed distance
Decelerate gradually and walk back for recovery

name: Sled Drag
instructions: Attach a strap to a loaded sled and hold the handles
Walk backward dragging the sled behind you
Maintain a low stance with core braced
Cover the prescribed distance

name: Foam Roll Quads
instructions: Lie face down with a foam roller under your thighs
Roll slowly from hip to just above the knee
Pause on any tender spots for 20-30 seconds
Use your arms to control the pressure

name: Foam Roll IT Band
instructions: Lie on your side with a foam roller under your outer thigh
Roll from hip to just above the knee
Pause on any tender spots for 20-30 seconds
Use your top leg to control the pressure

name: Foam Roll Lats
instructions: Lie on your side with a foam roller under your armpit area
Roll along the length of your lat from armpit to mid-back
Pause on any tender spots for 20-30 seconds

name: Foam Roll Thoracic Spine
instructions: Lie on your back with a foam roller under your upper back
Cross your arms over your chest or behind your head
Roll from mid-back to upper back
Extend over the roller to mobilize the thoracic spine

name: Foam Roll Hamstrings
instructions: Sit with a foam roller under your thighs
Roll from just below the glutes to above the knee
Pause on any tender spots for 20-30 seconds
Cross one leg over the other for more pressure

name: Foam Roll Calves
instructions: Sit with a foam roller under your calves
Roll from ankle to just below the knee
Pause on any tender spots for 20-30 seconds
Cross one leg over the other for more pressure

name: Foam Roll Glutes
instructions: Sit on a foam roller with one ankle crossed over the opposite knee
Lean toward the crossed side and roll over the glute
Pause on any tender spots for 20-30 seconds

name: Hip 90/90 Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg bent at 90 degrees in front and the other at 90 degrees behind
Keep your torso upright and lean forward over the front shin
Hold the stretch, then switch sides
Focus on opening through the hip

name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: Step into a deep lunge position
Place the hand opposite the front foot on the floor
Rotate your torso and reach the other arm toward the ceiling
Hold briefly, then switch sides

name: Cat-Cow
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips
Arch your back downward while lifting your head and tailbone (cow)
Round your back upward while tucking your chin and tailbone (cat)
Alternate slowly between positions

name: Banded Face Pull
instructions: Attach a band at face height
Pull the band apart toward your face with elbows high
Squeeze your rear delts and upper back at full contraction
Return with control

name: Banded Lateral Walk
instructions: Place a band around your ankles or above your knees
Stand in a quarter-squat position
Step sideways maintaining tension in the band
Complete prescribed steps in one direction, then return

name: Banded Squat
instructions: Loop a band under your feet and over your shoulders or hold at chest height
Squat down against the band's resistance
Drive up to standing

name: Banded Deadlift
instructions: Loop a band under your feet and over your hips or hold with hands
Hinge at the hips and slightly bend knees to lower
Drive hips forward to standing against band resistance

name: Banded Push-Up
instructions: Loop a resistance band across your upper back and hold the ends under your hands
Perform push-ups with the added band resistance at the top
Lower with control and press up against the band

name: Banded Row
instructions: Attach a band to a fixed point at chest height
Pull the band toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades
Return with control to full arm extension

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench pressing two dumbbells together with a neutral grip
Keep the dumbbells squeezed together throughout the movement
Press up to full extension maintaining inward pressure
Lower to chest while keeping dumbbells in contact

name: Behind-the-Neck Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at a lat pulldown station with a wide grip
Pull the bar down behind your head to neck level
Control the return to full extension
Use lighter weight and ensure adequate shoulder mobility

name: Prone Row
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with arms hanging down
Hold dumbbells or a barbell and row up toward the bench
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top
Lower with control

name: Viking Press
instructions: Set up landmine handles or a Viking press attachment
Stand or kneel between the handles at shoulder height
Press both handles overhead to full lockout
Lower with control to shoulders

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench inside the Smith machine with the bar at shoulder height
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width
Press up to full lockout
Lower with control back to shoulders

name: Lateral Raise (Cable, Behind Back)
instructions: Stand sideways to a low cable with the handle behind your back
Grip the handle with the far hand reaching behind you
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height
Lower with control

name: 21s (Barbell Curl)
instructions: Hold a barbell with an underhand grip
Perform 7 reps from the bottom to halfway up
Then 7 reps from halfway to the top
Finish with 7 full range-of-motion reps

name: EZ-Bar Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with armpits resting on the pad
Hold an EZ-bar with an underhand grip
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders
Lower with control to full extension

name: Cable Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with a low cable to one side
Rest your elbow on the inside of your thigh
Curl the cable handle toward your shoulder
Lower with control and complete all reps before switching

name: French Press (EZ-Bar)
instructions: Stand or sit holding an EZ-bar overhead with arms extended
Lower the bar behind your head by bending at the elbows
Keep your upper arms close to your head
Extend back to the starting position

name: Jefferson Squat
instructions: Straddle a barbell with one foot in front and one behind
Grip the bar with one hand in front and one behind
Squat down and stand back up keeping your torso upright
Alternate which foot is forward between sets

name: Hatfield Squat
instructions: Set up a safety squat bar on your back
Lightly hold the rack or safety handles in front for balance
Squat down to depth while using your hands for minimal support
Drive up to standing

name: ATG Split Squat
instructions: Stand in a split squat position with one foot elevated behind
Lower your back knee all the way to the floor (ass to grass depth)
Drive through the front foot to return to standing
Focus on full range of motion through the knee

name: Poliquin Step-Up
instructions: Stand on one foot on a 4-6 inch step
Let the other foot hang off the side
Lower the hanging foot by bending the working knee
Return to standing, focusing on the VMO (inner quad)

name: Sled Leg Press (Vertical)
instructions: Sit in a vertical leg press machine with feet on the platform
Lower the sled by bending your knees to 90 degrees
Press the sled up to full extension
Do not lock out your knees fully

name: 45-Degree Hip Extension
instructions: Position yourself face down on a 45-degree hip extension machine
Cross arms over chest or behind your head
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips
Raise back up by squeezing your glutes until body is in line with legs

name: Banded Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with upper back against a bench and a band across your hips
Anchor the band under your feet on each side
Drive your hips up toward the ceiling, squeezing glutes at the top
Lower with control

name: Smith Machine Lunge
instructions: Stand under a Smith machine bar with the bar on your upper back
Step one foot forward into a lunge position
Lower your back knee toward the floor
Drive through the front foot to return to standing

name: Dragon Flag
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip the edges behind your head
Raise your entire body off the bench until only your upper back/shoulders remain on the bench
Lower your body slowly as one rigid unit
Do not let your hips bend or sag

name: L-Sit
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars or dip handles with arms straight
Raise your legs until they are parallel to the floor
Hold the position with legs straight and core engaged
Maintain for the prescribed duration

name: Suitcase Carry
instructions: Hold a heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in one hand at your side
Walk forward maintaining an upright posture
Resist leaning to the weighted side
Walk for the prescribed distance, then switch hands

name: Ab Wheel (Kneeling)
instructions: Kneel on the floor holding an ab wheel in front of you
Roll the wheel forward, extending your body toward the floor
Go as far as you can without your body touching the floor
Use your abs to pull yourself back to the starting position

name: Hanging Windshield Wiper
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar and raise your legs up
Rotate your legs from side to side like a windshield wiper
Keep the movement controlled and your shoulders stable
Alternate sides

name: Man Maker
instructions: Start in a push-up position gripping two dumbbells
Perform a push-up, then row each dumbbell
Jump your feet to your hands and clean the dumbbells to your shoulders
Press overhead, then lower and repeat

name: Devil Press
instructions: Start standing with dumbbells at your sides
Perform a burpee with hands on the dumbbells
From the bottom, swing the dumbbells between your legs and overhead in one motion
Lower and repeat

name: Sandbag Clean
instructions: Stand over a sandbag with feet shoulder-width apart
Squat down and grip the sandbag
Explosively lift it to your chest/shoulder position
Lower with control and repeat

name: Rope Climb
instructions: Grip a climbing rope with both hands above your head
Wrap the rope around one foot for a footlock
Pull yourself up hand over hand, stepping up with your feet
Descend with control, lowering hand over hand

name: Prowler Push
instructions: Load the prowler sled and grip the high handles
Drive forward with powerful leg strides
Keep your body at a forward lean with arms extended
Push for the prescribed distance

name: Sledgehammer Swing
instructions: Stand next to a large tire holding a sledgehammer
Raise the hammer overhead
Swing it down forcefully onto the tire
Control the rebound and repeat

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell on the floor ahead
Hinge at the hips and grip the kettlebell with both hands
Hike the bell back between your legs then drive hips forward explosively
Swing the bell to chest or shoulder height, arms straight
Control the descent and repeat in a continuous motion
